'''Elegar''' is minor Lord in [[Andor]] and a [[Darkfriend]] under [[Rahvin]]'s command. 

== Appearance ==
He is thin lipped and always nervous.

== Activities ==
He is commanded by Rahvin to take the [[Red Ajah]] [[Aes Sedai]] who is under Rahvin's compulsion, outside the royal palace.{{ref/book|5|p}}

After Gaebril's demise he is one of the nobles who fawn over [[Rand al'Thor]].
